artworks.title: Masquerade
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The painting depicts a group of people in a room with a musical performance underway, and an audience observing from a gallery above. The interior setting includes figures in colorful garments, some wearing striped tunics, red hats, and others with plumed helmets. The individuals seem to be participating in a lively event, potentially a dance or ceremony. Two figures are playing musical instruments — a flute and a drum. The colors are bright, creating a festive atmosphere. Above them, a window shows spectators in lighter attire watching the scene. The composition conveys a sense of medieval revelry or celebration, resembling a medieval manuscript or illustration.

artworks.title: Sister Rosalie (Soeur Rosalie)
artworks.medium: engraving and (photo process?)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman wearing a traditional nun's habit, including a cornette covering her head and shoulders. She has mature facial features, with deep-set eyes and a slightly downturned mouth. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Leo XIII
artworks.medium: engraving and (photo process?)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of an individual's upper body in a three-quarter view, facing slightly left. The person has a wise countenance with a gentle expression, deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a subtle smile. The individual has short, neatly combed back hair that appears gray or white and is dressed in formal clerical attire, including a white buttoned robe with a visible chain or cord across the chest. The background features a detailed oval frame enclosing the portrait, with a decorative coat of arms displaying a papal tiara and crossed keys below. Inscriptions of "LEO XIII" and "PONTIFEX MAXIMUS" are found on a plinth beneath the portrait, all presented in an engraved style.

artworks.title: Pius IX
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait depicted from the chest up in an oval frame. He has short, neatly combed hair and a smooth complexion. The man is wearing ceremonial ecclesiastical clothing, including a cloak, a high-collared garment, and a visible chain around his neck. The frame is decorated with an ornate coat of arms featuring papal insignia at the bottom center. The background inside the oval is plain, while the outside is bordered. The name "PIVS IX" and title "PONTIFEX MAXIMVS" are inscribed on a stone panel below the oval.

artworks.title: Masquerade
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a festive scene depicting a group of figures in ornate attire. The central figure is playing a drum. In the background, there is a platform. Onlookers are watching from the side. The setting is historical or ceremonial. The style resembles an illuminated manuscript, with detailed and colorful depictions of societal events.

artworks.title: The Poor Family (Une famille pauvre)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals shown from nearly full body to full body within the frame. The person on the left is reclining against a surface, leaning back with their head tilted slightly downwards. Their facial features are shadowed, with medium-length, somewhat unkempt hair. They are wearing dark, textured clothing, and their feet are visible, dressed in worn shoes. The central figure is seated and appears to be looking down, with long, dark hair cascading forward and partially obscuring their face. They are dressed in a light, loose-fitting garment. To the right, a child is sitting, resting their head on their forearms, with short hair framing their face. The scene is set in a dim background, with textured walls and shadows.

artworks.title: The Model and the Figure (La sculpture monumentale)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, positioned in a three-quarter view with her body facing forward and her head turned slightly to the side. She has delicate facial features with softly arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. Her hair is dark, wavy, and of medium length, falling around her shoulders. She is dressed in a loose-fitting garment with wide sleeves, which has a textured appearance. The woman holds a slender object in one hand, crossed over her chest. Behind her is a ghostly, veiled figure resembling a statue. The background consists of textured, shaded vertical drapes. There is a small rectangular object with a cylindrical handle near her waist.

artworks.title: After the Pardon  (Il lui sera beaucoup pardonne parce qu'elle a beaucoup danse)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in bed with only the upper part of their body visible. The person is positioned on their side, facing us, with their head resting on a pillow. They have dark, curly hair that falls around their face, which has relaxed features as they appear to be asleep. The person is wearing a dark, loose garment that reveals their shoulders. The bedding around them appears plush, with blankets gathered loosely, and the scene is surrounded by draped fabric or curtains. On the ground beside the bed, there is a hat and a ribbon. The overall background is dim with heavy drapery.

artworks.title: Discussion of Budget
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The graphite drawing features two people, with their upper bodies visible. A woman is leaning forward behind a chair, peering closely over the shoulder of a seated man. The woman's hair is styled in an updo, revealing a smooth forehead and delicate facial features, including slightly arched eyebrows and a gentle gaze. She wears a high-collared blouse with intricate detailing. The man, seated with his torso facing slightly away from the viewer, has a mustache and a concentrated expression. His hair is short, and he wears a patterned robe. His focus is directed onto a sheet of paper, which he holds close to a table. The background shows draped curtains and a framed artwork.

artworks.title: The Masked Ball
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a lively setting. The sketch shows people in various postures, interacting with each other in a dynamic manner. There is a sense of energy and movement, with some individuals positioned on an elevated section in the background. The forms are fluid, with strong lines and shading creating depth. The atmosphere is one of exuberance and spontaneity, captured in a classic style with attention to light and shadow.

artworks.title: Alexander Gabriel Descamps
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a relaxed posture. He is facing slightly to the left, with his head turned forward. The man has a full beard and mustache, neatly styled hair, and is wearing a long, loose-fitting garment resembling a robe. He also wears boots and holds a small book in his left hand. In the background, there is a large draped curtain to the right and a decorative piece of furniture on the left side. The setting is depicted with attention to line and texture, highlighting details of clothing and background elements.

artworks.title: Reverie
artworks.medium: pen and gray and red ink, heightened with white, on darkened paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright, holding a stick or cane in their right hand. They have a detailed face with a prominent nose and a contemplative expression. The individual wears a headscarf covering most of their hair and a long, heavy overcoat. Their oversized shoes and the plain brown background with diagonal sketch lines provide context to the image.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a drawing of the upper three-quarters of a person's profile facing left. The person is depicted in a seated or hunched position, with their body slightly bent forward. Their facial features are detailed with a prominent nose and light hatching to show aging contours. The person wears a hat or head covering that obscures their hair, and loose, flowing clothing typical of a robe or cloak. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is plain with crosshatching lines for depth.

artworks.title: C'etais "pour se donner des forces"
artworks.medium: pen and brown, blue and red ink, heightened with white, on brown prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, leaning forward with his right hand resting on a ledge. He has rugged facial features, including a short beard and unruly hair. The man is dressed in a loose, plain-colored long-sleeved shirt, loose pants, and simple shoes. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown and red ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing person with their hands in the pockets of their jacket. The person is facing forward with a slightly hunched posture, head slightly tilted downward. The face shows detailed features like a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and an open mouth. The person wears a cap covering most of their hair, a loose jacket, baggy pants, and simple shoes. There are no visible accessories or items in their hands. The background is plain with faint scribbled lines and light brown spots scattered on the textured surface.

artworks.title: Et pas le Sou pour Souper
artworks.medium: pen and red and brown ink with watercolor, heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing from the waist up. The person on the left has curly hair, hands in pockets, and wears an open-collared shirt, light-colored pants, and a hat with a wide brim. The individual on the right has tightly curled hair, hands on hips, and wears a pointed hat with a feather and a shaggy-textured garment. The background is a minimal wash of color with no distinguishable features.

artworks.title: English Beggar
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor, heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one hand on his hip and the other holding a stick or cane. He has curly hair and a beard. He is wearing a long dark coat, a blue tunic, and red patterned trousers. A hat and a white cloth are on the ground near his feet. The background has a textured wall on the right and an earth-toned backdrop with some greenery near the ground.

artworks.title: Wayside Shrine in Brittany (Le calvaire Breton)
artworks.medium: woodcut on very thin Japan paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mythical and animal figures in a pastoral setting. The drawing is done in a style reminiscent of traditional woodcuts, utilizing strong contrast with black ink on a light background. On the left side, there are several humanoid figures with stylized facial features, who appear to be observing or participating in a scene with animals. In the center and to the right, a prominent bull, goats, and other creatures are depicted, suggesting a procession or gathering. The composition is dense with overlapping forms, and the lines used are bold and expressive, lending a dramatic aesthetic to the scene. The artwork combines elements of folklore with natural imagery to create a visually rich tableau.

artworks.title: Mahana Atua (Day of the Gods)
artworks.medium: woodcut on China paper
artworks.description: The image displays flowing, curvilinear lines and shapes giving it an abstract quality. The forms suggest figures and natural elements. Shapes in the upper portion resemble standing or walking figures. In the center and lower areas, lines sweep and curve to imply a flowing surface resembling water, and a form of a person beside a tree. The composition is filled with dynamic and organic shapes, creating an impression of a landscape with human activity, abstracted to emphasize fluidity and movement. Bold black and white contrasts add depth and enhance details within the shapes.

artworks.title: Tahitian Carrying Bananas (Le porteur de fei)
artworks.medium: woodcut

artworks.title: Te Atua (The Gods) Small Plate [recto]
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on very thin Japan paper, mounted face down
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of sinuous lines and curved shapes assembled in a rectangular composition with an arch at the top. This abstract depiction showcases a variety of elements that suggest familiar objects. At the top, a curving form resembles a stylized face with elongated features, while below, flowing lines mimic the appearance of serpentine figures or aquatic creatures. Flanking the central section are two human-like shapes reminiscent of classical sculptures, one on each side, which appear to be enclosed in a space akin to a framed relief. The intricate layering of shapes is punctuated by text and smaller circular elements.

artworks.title: Te Atua (The Gods) Small Plate [verso]
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts abstract human-like figures and elements. It shows a central figure lying down with striking black lines and contrasts. There are other shapes and outlines surrounding the figure, blending into a textured background. The use of space and lines creates movement and interaction between the elements, giving the drawing an eerie atmosphere. Sections are divided with arcs and lines, creating distinct yet connected sections within the composition.

artworks.title: Te Atua (The Gods) Small Plate
artworks.medium: two laminated woodcuts on Japanese paper, double-mounted on wove paper
artworks.description: The image consists of various shapes and lines forming figures and patterns. At the top is an arch-like shape enclosing a stylized face with flowing hair. Below, figures interact in a scene with curved lines creating a sense of movement. Two human-like figures are on either side, while abstract animal forms resembling a fowl or rooster are in the center. Swirling lines at the bottom suggest water or snakes, adding to the intricate and symbolic nature of the image.

artworks.title: Human Misery (Misères humaines)
artworks.medium: woodcut on Japan paper, perimeter mounted
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract composition of flowing and curved lines. In the center, a figure with stylized hair appears in a thoughtful pose. The background contains abstract shapes suggesting a tree or bush, along with circular elements resembling fruit or foliage. Abstract forms like hearts and symbols are visible towards the bottom left. The arrangement of lines and shapes creates a scene connecting figures and natural settings in an abstract style.
